source: Fleisig et al. (2002), Figure 5, Sports Engineering 5:1–8
plottingNotes: Top (a) axes: horizontal X(m) 0..3, vertical Y(m) -1..2.
Side (b) axes: horizontal X(m) 0..3, vertical Z(m) 0..1.4.
Bat marker locations in each figure are illustrated every 5 ms, but the source does not label each segment with a frame number.
Only axes can be read with high confidence; dense strokes can overlap, and the thick start/end bat lines are not necessarily the 0.56 m marker-to-marker segment.
Both panels share X coordinate in the original experiment. Screen-pixel measurements are approximate and must be verified using the rendered original.
No image pixels copied into repository; uses externally linked source.
